# Ruud amends criterion 5

Recorded on 24 September 2026 on Ruud's instruction, in answer to F3 of the first
review (note 39) and G5 of the second (note 47), which found the amendment stated
in the ticket file with no record behind it.

He was given three options and chose the first:

1. **Amend criterion 5 on his authority**, so that SEEN-105 delivers the
   measurement, the attribution and the report row, and the figure is read from the
   sprint 0 report once the first ticket worked with both agents from its first
   session has delivered, which is SEEN-106.
2. Deliver with criterion 5 unchecked.
3. Hold the ticket at review until SEEN-106 has delivered.

His words, as the option he selected states them: "criterion 5 is amended. SEEN-105
delivers the measurement and the attribution; the figure is read from the sprint 0
report when SEEN-106 delivers, being the first ticket worked with both agents from
its first session."

The reason the criterion cannot be met as written inside this ticket: its own first
two sessions were spent before either agent existed, so its figures are not the
figures the criterion asks about. G4 of the second review then found that the row
would have counted this ticket anyway; `[context] agents_available_from` now holds
the timestamp of the commit that generated the two agents, so a ticket that
installed them is not counted as worked with them, which is the rule SEEN-098 wrote
for its own tool.

The record is written by the session at his instruction rather than typed by him,
which is why the actor is `human:implementer` and this paragraph says so. The
ticket's `## Amendments` section carries the same decision where a reader of the
ticket will find it.
